# openbim-ifc-cli

The openbim-ifc command: validate, convert, inspect, query and edit IFC files (STEP, ifcXML and ifcZIP), and exchange their values as CSV, TSV or XLSX tables, from a shell or CI.

## Overview

`openbim-ifc`: validate, convert, inspect and query IFC files from a shell or CI.

A thin command layer over the `openbim-ifc` facade: every answer comes
from a facade call, and this crate only parses arguments, picks a codec
and formats the result. Nothing here interprets IFC on its own.
